Yes, that is exactly why your messages aren't going through. The airplane icon means that "Airplane Mode" is turned on. 

When Airplane Mode is active, it turns off all wireless connections, including your cellular service. This prevents your phone from sending texts, making calls, or sending those picture messages (MMS) you're trying to send to your daughter.

Please don't worry, I can help you turn it off safely. To turn it off, I will need to perform a "toggle" action. May I have your permission to turn off Airplane Mode for you?

steps.action_text:
I understand that seeing "No Signal" and "Data Disabled" can be concerning, but please don't worry. Since we just turned off Airplane Mode, your phone is now trying to reconnect to the network.

"Data Disabled" simply means that while your cellular radio is back on, the switch to use that connection for internet and data (which includes sending those picture messages) is currently off.

I can turn that on for you now. May I have your permission to enable your mobile data?
